evidence.rule: Experimental attention threshold on a daily external probability; not EVA risk.

limitations: Forecast probability is not observed astronaut radiation dose.

evidence.rule: Earth-shadow geometry; relevant only when the plan requires direct sunlight.

limitations: Solar vector and cylindrical Earth shadow are approximate.
Illumination is an operational constraint, not a standalone claim of danger.
Historical orbital elements have no verified publication time; geometry is reconstruction.
